name: Kill the tumour cells that are there
description: Eliminate the bulk glioblastoma population — surgically, with radiation and chemotherapy, or with a targeted agent — measured by radiographic response.

grade.note: Radiotherapy with concomitant and adjuvant temozolomide extended median survival from 12.1 to 14.6 months and two-year survival from 10% to 26% in a randomised phase 3 trial (Stupp 2005), and alternating electric fields added a further increment (Stupp 2017). This is L5 for the intervention and a statement about the disease: two decades of standard care buys months. The tumour is not eradicated in anyone.
grade.drift: 'Standard of care for glioblastoma' sounds like treatment with intent to cure. Median survival is under two years.

wouldMove: Any intervention that shifts the whole survival curve rather than adding months to the median.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
